PARAMETRIC_CONSTRUCTION_RULE.rule: BINDING ON LATER ACTS: all M7 artwork is built PARAMETRIC on this substrate — every dimension consumed by reference to a named field of this record, never hard-coded — so that a caliper session (or the vendor's pan-cavity answer) RE-FLOWS the artwork rather than requiring it to be redrawn. An act that hard-codes a DERIVED_BOUNDED_NOT_MEASURED number has violated this rule even if the number later proves right.

die_cut_question.extent_A564: predicate: any die / cut / kiss-cut layer, spot colour, or distinguishing stroke on the 24 label rects; population: every drawing on the vendor page via get_drawings (stroke colour and width per path), plus the dip0b dieline review's line classes. RESULT: the label rects are stroked 'fs' in the same near-black (0.006,0.005,0.006) as the sheet boundary and general linework — NOT in the red (0.90,0.10,0.10) the display box uses for its cut/crease marks; the review counts CUT_LINE_CANDIDATE=1 (the box contour), registration ink unused, and MuPDF flattens layer structure. Nothing in the file distinguishes the label rects as die lines OR as printed keylines.
die_cut_question.consequence: the 6mm-gutter kiss-cut reading is a PLAUSIBLE INFERENCE (sticker sheets usually are; the vendor photo shows applied labels) but the file does not establish it — and if the near-black rects ARE the cut paths, T2's printed keyline would ride at the die edge and possibly duplicate a cut visual. Discharged by: the VENDOR's die specification, same discharger as the stock parameter.

SET_FACE.style_constraint_carried_from_census: ONLY Regular carries the in-file OFL declaration; Bold/Italic/SemiBold are fsType 0 but undeclared, standing by family provenance only. THE SHEET NEEDS ONLY REGULAR — the cleaner answer — so no fresh fetch is required for this artifact; any future use of another style fetches the family fresh from its source with its OFL.txt.

TYPEFACE_SPEC_2026_08_14.fit_rule_as_constraint: for whatever face is set: the single largest size at which the longest name fits (label_w - 2*pad_x) AND ascent+descent fits (label_h - 2*pad_y), solved against the face's own metrics at render time. NO solved size is ever recorded as a constant.
TYPEFACE_SPEC_2026_08_14.no_outlining: BINDING: no type is outlined in any working file or intermediate. Outlining is a step for a licensed final only. Rasterizing a PNG render is not outlining; converting text to paths in a vector file is.
